title: 工業園區水能資源整合
titleEn: Industrial Park Water and Energy Integration
summary: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Double-counting recovered heat at two plants.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.title: 單元1｜物料收得：機制與界面
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Material yield: Mechanism and interfaces
steps.objective: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」完成機制與界面並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete mechanism and interfaces for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」。畫出「投入 → 庫存 → 有效成果 → 回收 → 功能單位」並圈出與「物料收得」有關的介面。將 100*good/feed 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：同一批次、同一乾濕基準的合格質量除以投入質量。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks. Draw Inputs → Inventory → Accepted outputs → Recovery → Functional unit and mark the interfaces relevant to Material yield. Place every variable of 100*good/feed on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Divide accepted mass by feed mass for one batch on the same moisture basis. Identify what it cannot establish: Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.
steps.observation: 對照「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」，輸入變數與量測結果不同：先定義可觀察量，再決定能否使用這個式子。前五單元把共通物理模型套入本課案例；這是局部子系統估算，不是整座設施模型。
steps.observationEn: For Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks, distinguish inputs from observed outcomes before deciding whether this equation applies. A shared physical model is applied to the case subsystem, not a complete facility model.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜物料收得：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Material yield: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」的「物料收得」採以下合成教學值：good=84 kg；feed=100 kg。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 100*good/feed；獨立基準為 84 %。把 good 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 92.4 %。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks, use synthetic inputs for Material yield: good=84 kg；feed=100 kg. Check dimensions before evaluating 100*good/feed; the independent benchmark is 84 %. Increase good by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 92.4 %. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: good增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 8.4 %。有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 8.4 %. Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.
steps.check: 原值重算與 84 % 相符；10%案例與 92.4 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 84 % at baseline and 92.4 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（%）？
quiz.explanation: 按 100*good/feed 逐項代入，結果為 84；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into 100*good/feed gives 84; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜物料收得：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Material yield: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」設計「物料收得」的獨立驗證：分別秤量進料、合格料、廢料與庫存變化，保留批號和秤的零點。 以同一功能單位和期間對帳，回收支流只記一次並保留存量變化。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks, independently verify Material yield: Weigh feed, accepted output, rejects and inventory change; retain lot IDs and balance zero. Use one functional unit and period; count recycle once and retain stock changes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Double-counting recovered heat at two plants rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「有庫存、添加物或含水率變化時，先補齊支流；不能只靠比值判定物料守恆。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Account for inventory, additives and moisture changes before inferring mass conservation.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 保留原始資料並執行：分別秤量進料、合格料、廢料與庫存變化，保留批號和秤的零點。
只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Weigh feed, accepted output, rejects and inventory change; retain lot IDs and balance zero.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」。以本單元「物料收得」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「分別秤量進料、合格料、廢料與庫存變化，保留批號和秤的零點。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Double-counting recovered heat at two plants. For Material yield, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Weigh feed, accepted output, rejects and inventory change; retain lot IDs and balance zero. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.

steps.observation: capacity增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 2 h。需求率、可用容量與備援保留若變動，不能用平均值保證連續服務。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 2 h. Variable demand, usable capacity and reserves prevent a mean-based continuity guarantee.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；需求率、可用容量與備援保留若變動，不能用平均值保證連續服務。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Variable demand, usable capacity and reserves prevent a mean-based continuity guarantee.
steps.check: 原值重算與 20 h 相符；10%案例與 22 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 20 h at baseline and 22 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（h）？
quiz.explanation: 按 capacity/demand 逐項代入，結果為 20；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into capacity/demand gives 20; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜容量覆蓋時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Capacity duration: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」設計「容量覆蓋時間」的獨立驗證：對合成峰值和平均需求各計一次，保留保留量和不可用量。 以同一功能單位和期間對帳，回收支流只記一次並保留存量變化。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks, independently verify Capacity duration: Calculate for synthetic peak and mean demand, retaining reserve and unavailable amounts. Use one functional unit and period; count recycle once and retain stock changes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Double-counting recovered heat at two plants rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；需求率、可用容量與備援保留若變動，不能用平均值保證連續服務。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Variable demand, usable capacity and reserves prevent a mean-based continuity guarantee.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「需求率、可用容量與備援保留若變動，不能用平均值保證連續服務。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Variable demand, usable capacity and reserves prevent a mean-based continuity guarantee.

steps.objective: 以「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」。以本單元「容量覆蓋時間」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「對合成峰值和平均需求各計一次，保留保留量和不可用量。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Double-counting recovered heat at two plants. For Capacity duration, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Calculate for synthetic peak and mean demand, retaining reserve and unavailable amounts. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能」不是單靠 20 h 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 20 h alone cannot exclude Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 同一回收熱量在兩廠重複計節能；需求率、可用容量與備援保留若變動，不能用平均值保證連續服務。
steps.failureEn: Double-counting recovered heat at two plants; Variable demand, usable capacity and reserves prevent a mean-based continuity guarantee.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「工業園區跨廠水流、蒸汽與功能邊界」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Interplant water, steam and functional boundaries in industrial parks and retaining failed cases.
